limits: Only actual original FIRE5/SPE35 is newly accepted; shared35 skills11/18 keep the old route and were not newly cast.
Full160x96 presentation retains actual LCD outside65x64; this is not a complete HD battle background.
Eight source copies and measured LCD callbacks are distinct; coalesced callbacks do not prove every physical display frame.
Ten new mobile tests use controlled VM ABI/public getters and real ROM identity; no new mobile C/browser or real Android/iOS acceptance.

Classic actual FIRE/movie/NUM/HOLD remains pending: v1 cursor ACK tool error, v2/v3 natural no-FIRE attempts all remain unaccepted; controlled fallback tests and actual cursor movement do not replace an actual cast.
Other skills/periods, custom gameplay, full campaign/save/RNG continuity, visibility/resize matrix, performance and whole HD remain pending.
